title: Missing Backend Endpoint for Org Status Page Config (GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/status)
description: When navigating to /settings/organization, api.statusPageConfig(orgId) requests GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/status which returns HTTP 500 because the controller route is not implemented in the backend.
expected: HTTP 200 with status page JSON or safe fallback defaults
actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (No static resource)
suggested_fix: Implement @GetMapping('/organizations/{orgId}/status') in backend and add .catch() fallback in frontend

title: Missing Favicon Static Asset Returns HTTP 404
description: Browser requests /favicon.ico on document load, which returns HTTP 404 Not Found.

title: Missing Accessible aria-label Attributes on Icon-Only Buttons
description: Action icon buttons lack text or aria-label attributes, causing screen readers to announce them as empty buttons.
steps: Observe missing aria-label attributes on icon-only buttons
expected: All icon-only buttons provide descriptive aria-label attributes
actual: Buttons contain only SVG icons with no accessible label
suggested_fix: Add aria-label and title attributes to all button elements

title: Project Creation Wizard Step 1 Missing Explicit Bottom Cancel Button
description: Step 1 of the New Project modal does not provide an explicit Cancel button in the bottom action bar, requiring users to use the top-right X or Esc key.
steps: Click '+ NEW PROJECT' on projects page
Notice absence of a Cancel button
expected: Secondary Cancel button placed alongside primary progression button
actual: Only primary 'Next: Connect SDK ->' button exists in footer
suggested_fix: Add secondary Cancel button to dismiss modal
